name: Hinata Kento
source:
Gentle and level-headed, Hinata Kento is a professor who teaches science at Morning Glory Academy. He is the eldest among the teachers but has the most sense of humor. Hinata enjoys playing video games, watching anime, and reading manga. After recently going through a divorce, Hinata finds himself going to the bars to escape the hardships of reality. He is good at masking his feelings and dislikes conflict.

[From Kickstarter]
